title: Italian Fried Tomato Fritters
description: Crispy, flavorful fritters filled with fresh tomatoes, perfect as an appetizer or side dish.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, parmesan cheese, and italian seasoning.
Add diced tomatoes and mix until well combined.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
